mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (event_id, recipient_id, actor_id, action_type, entity_type, entity_id, content) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{recipientId}, #{actorId}, #{actionType}, #{entityType}, #{entityId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT n.id AS id, n.actor_id AS actorId, u.nickname AS actorNickname, u.avatar AS actorAvatar, n.action_type AS actionType, n.entity_type AS entityType, CAST(n.entity_id AS CHAR) AS entityId, n.content AS content, n.is_read AS isRead, n.created_at AS createdAt FROM notification n LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = n.actor_id WHERE n.recipient_id = #{recipientId} ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM notification WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = 1 WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND is_read = 0
UPDATE notification SET is_read = 1 where recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND entity_type=#{entityType} AND is_read=0 AND entity_id=#{entityId}
